     - top failure modes / weakest modules

- Ensure `experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml` and `experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml` exist and reference valid modules/specs.
- Make sure your environment has consistent seeds/configs if reproducibility matters (some autopilots assume env vars).
